segments.text: Based on Date Masamune, who was a regional strongman of Japan's Azuchi-Momoyama period through early Edo period. Heir to a long line of powerful daimyo in the Tōhoku region, he went on to found the modern-day city of Sendai. An outstanding tactician, he was made all the more iconic for his missing eye, and Date was often called dokuganryū (独眼竜), or the "one-eyed dragon".
"You have our commendations for your outstanding work!"
ジパングの東北に位置する奥州の領主。
海辺で倒れていた主人公を発見し、連れ帰って自分の所有物（弟）として扱う。
持ち前の強引さと豪快さで、主人公の背中を押す姉的存在。
一人称は「それがし」。口癖も「それがし」。
「一難去ってまたそれがし」「それがしあれば憂いなし」「立てば芍薬、座ればそれがし」「それがしな奴（褒め言葉）」など、節々にさり気なく（？）「それがし」を混ぜて喋る。
真面目な話をする際は、通訳として主人公の付き添いが必要。
主人公を弟に据え、ジパング統一を目論む。

segments.text: Based on Marie Antoinette, born an Archduchess of Austria, who was Dauphine of France from 1770 to 1774 and Queen of France and Navarre from 1774 to 1792.

One of the most well-known nobles of France. She treats everybody like they were under her and is shown to be extremely confident in herself, such as calling herself the goddess of victory. She also somehow gathers gold and silver all around her despite not doing anything.
"I, Marie Antoinette, shall hear your plea."
すさまじく高飛車なフランスの貴族。
誰に対しても、いかなる状況下でも、上から目線。
世界中の人は、全て自分のために存在すると考えている。
しかし、思考スケールが小さいので、あまり嫌われてはいない。
どういうわけか、マリーの元には何もしなくても金銀財宝が集まってくるのだが、本人の浪費癖が激しすぎて、ちっとも手元に残らない。
他の英雄に「いいからケーキでも食べてて」的な扱いを受けている。
世界がマリー・アントワネットに注目しておりますわ
天に愛されし英雄を自称し、実際その辺を歩くだけで道端の金塊に躓くほどの豪運。
ただし宵越しの銭は持たない性分なのか、折角得たお金は湯水の如く使われる。

Based on Hercules, who was a divine hero in Greek mythology, the son of Zeus and Alcmene, foster son of Amphitryon and great-grandson (and half-brother) of Perseus. He was the greatest of the Greek heroes, a paragon of masculinity, the ancestor of royal clans who claimed to be Heracleidae and a champion of the Olympian order against chthonic monsters.
She watches over the dark realm.
"I still can't seem to have enough power!"
幻想都市アルカディアで暮らす古代英雄。
片手で石柱を振り回すほどの圧倒的な力を持っている。
豪快で男勝りな性格。ものすごく体が大きい。
地獄門シュオルの監視役。
この見た目でパワーキャラじゃなかったら嘘だろ……？
安心してください、常にフルパワーな不屈な戦士ですよ。
Based on Achilles, who was a Greek hero of the Trojan War and the central character and greatest warrior of Homer's Iliad.
”You think that’s even nearly fast enough to keep up? Hah!”
幻想都市エリュシオンで暮らす古代英雄。
目にも留まらぬ速さで動くことができる、最速の英雄。
自身のスピードに絶対の自身をもっている。
やや高慢なところがあるが、自分が認めた相手には好意的に接するらしい。
海底都市アトランティスの監視役。
駿足の古代英雄：
カリブ海の海中にある何かを監視しているらしい。
そんな動きで付いてこれると思ってるの？
Based on Siegfried, who is one of the heroes in the German Nibelungenlied, and Richard Wagner's operas Siegfried and Götterdämmerung.
She seems to be watching something in the dense fog region of Northern Europe.
"You'd better go back. There's a commotion in the forest."
幻想都市ヴァルハラで暮らす古代英雄。
全身を自在に硬質化させることができるため、鉄壁の防御力を誇る。
自然や動物が好きで、趣味は森林浴。
物静かだが、少し落ち込みやすい。
冥界都市ポホヨラの監視役。
鉄壁の古代英雄：ジークフリート
北欧の濃霧地方にある何かを監視しているらしい。
帰った方がいいでしょう。森がざわついています

Based on Jiang Ziya, who was an ancient Chinese military strategist who helped King Wen and King Wu of Zhou overthrow the Shang dynasty. As the founder of the state of Qi, his posthumous title is Duke Tai of Qi.
The ancient king of the Illusive City. She often breaks the fourth wall.
幻想都市崑崙で暮らす古代英雄。
宝貝と呼ばれる不思議な道具を自在に操り、多勢との闘いを得意としている。
この世界はゲームの中の出来事だと信じており、悟ったような、メタ的な発言を繰り返す。
地底遺跡シャンバラの監視役。
全知の古代英雄：太公望
大華帝国の山奥にある何かを監視しているらしい。
わかってると思うけど、シャンバラのことだよ
"Ahh, the light of a peaceful world shines here and now... The light that will envelop the world fills this very room..."
Based on King Arthur, who was the legendary British leader of the late 5th and early 6th centuries.
An idol hero who charms everyone with her overflowing charisma. Arthur travels around the world with her knights of the Round Table in order to create a peaceful world free of conflict.

She has come to Yamatai in order to see for herself the Hero who unified Zipang. She firmly believes that love is the answer to everything, which is why she wants of fill the whole world with it. However, her "love conquest" has been postponed many times because nobody actually knows what it means.
Edited from English official site
世界最強の軍事力を有するブリタニアの王。
すべては愛で解決できると考えており、平和で幸せな世界をつくるため、愛による世界征服を目論んでいる。
が、“愛による世界征服”というのがちっとも具体的でないため、ブリタニアによる世界征服計画は無期延期状態。
しかし、それもひとつの愛の形だと思っている。ある意味、愛の探求者。
全身から放つカリスマオーラで人々を魅了するアイドル英雄。
アーサーが微笑むと、世界のどこかで小さな（？）奇跡が起きるらしい。
争いのない平和な世界を作るために円卓の騎士と共に世界中を飛び回っており、ジパングの内乱を平定した主人公を一目見ようと邪馬台までやってくる。
"Those who believe are saved. Those who are right in their way are blessed with good fortune."
Based on Ashoka, who was an Indian emperor of the Maurya Dynasty who ruled almost all of the Indian subcontinent from circa 269 BCE to 232 BCE.

The ruler of India, a law-governed country. She is too trusting toward others, and is easily tricked. Dead set against violating discipline and morals, she devotes continuous effor to change India into a country where all the people can live in peace. She used to wield violence to reinforce her point, but having realized that a conflict only brings more conflicts, she has steeled her temper.
From English official site

人を疑うことを知らない善人で、誰でもすぐに信用してしまう。
規律や風紀に厳しく、国民が安心して暮らせる国を目指し、日々勉強を重ねている。

Based on Atlas, who was the primordial Titan who held up the celestial spheres. He is also the titan of astronomy and navigation in the Greek mythology.
She’s been locked away for a long time, waiting for someone to boot her up once more.
”Order acknowledged. Commencing annihilation.”
海底都市アトランティスに眠る古代兵器。
他の英雄や古代英雄を凌ぐ、圧倒的な性能を秘めている。
自身を起動してくれたダ・ヴィンチを母のように慕うが、他の英雄達のことは「小さき者達」と呼び、ほとんど歯牙にもかけない。
機械でプログラムされたような性格。アドリブがきかない。
在EU领地里的遗迹内发掘出来的古代英雄。被发现时浑身伤痕，但她拥有压倒性的性能。
"Oh dear... who is our opponent?"
Based on Aristotle, a legendary-like Greek philosopher and scientist.

The highly capable military officer who's also taken it upon herself to educate Alexander to become a good king. It is said that the overwhelming strength of the Macedonian forces is all by grace of Aristotle's teachings. She is acquainted with various academics and loved by everyone from soldies to civilians because she impartially shares her knowledge with them all.
Aristotle has a strong desire for marriage despite being extremely shy in front of people of the opposite sex. She reads away guidebooks on how to get along with men.
From English official site
アレキサンダーに王としての教育を施す マケドニアの優秀な参謀。
現在のマケドニア軍の強さは彼女の教育のおかげと言われている。
様々な学問に通じており、その知識を別け隔てなく与えているため、兵士や民衆からも慕われている。
男性に対する免疫が無いが、結婚願望は強く、アレキサンドリア図書館の一角に、男性と仲良くなるためのハウトゥー本を隠しているらしい。

Based on Alexander the Great or Alexander III of Macedon, who was a King of the Ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon.

The ruler of Macedonia, the great center of trade in control the Silk Road. Alexander has a simple and straightforward personality, being fond of anything amusing or grandiose. She is a free-spirited king, always laughing things out with a "Wahahaha!".
She holds great respect for Aristotle and addresses her as teacher. She has this habit of bestowing the name "Alexandria" on everything and everyone she takes a fancy to.
From English official site

面白いもの、派手なものを好む単純明快な性格をしている。
いつも「わっはっは」と笑っている奔放な王。
アリストテレスを先生と呼び慕い、色んなことを教えてもらっている。

"Heh, hehehe... I'm looking forward to your punishment."

Based on Ivan the Terrible, who was the Grand Prince of Moscow from 1533 to 1547 and Tsar of All the Russias from 1547 until his death. Ivan managed countless changes in the progression from a medieval state to an empire and emerging regional power, and became the first ruler to be crowned as Tsar of All the Russians.

The hero ruling the harsh lands of Russia. Ivan was born a super sadist who takes joy in inflicting pain on others and torturing them for her amusement. While she favors Rasputin due to her tenacity that lets her survive any punishments given, Ivan feels irritated seeing her get more ecstatic after each one.
Since all the Russian citizens are masochists, that makes Ivan the most ideal ruler in a sense.
From English official site
極寒の国ロシアの統治者。
臣下への思いやりあふれる英雄で、ロシア全土で慕われている。
雷帝の期待に応えるべく、限界を突破しつづける兵士たちは、常人を遥かに凌駕する能力を有しており、他国に類を見ないほど屈強らしい。
雷帝の考案した壁の無い兵舎は「解放感がある」「見晴らしがいい」「ひぎぃ」と大変好評で柔らかな雪のシーツ、北風布団などの天然素材をふんだんに使った内装で注目を集め、さらには徒歩8日（※行軍速度35km/h 一日21時間行軍で計算）の近場にカムチャッカの天然マグマ温泉（約900度）を完備したことで入隊希望者が殺到。ドＭ国家、ロシアの理想の君主である。
極寒の国・ロシアを統べる英雄。
人を痛めつけることが大好きな生粋のドSで、家臣や配下兵に理由なき暴力を振るうのが趣味。
どれだけ痛めつけても死なないラスプーチンを気に入っており、暇があればいじめている。
臣下は皆ハイレベルな M ばかりなので、ある意味、最高の君主。
"S-S-S-Sorry. Sorry I was ever born!"

Based on William Kidd (c. 22 January 1645 – 23 May 1701) who was a Scottish sailor who was tried and executed for piracy after returning from a voyage to the Indian Ocean. Kidd's fame springs largely from the sensational circumstances of his questioning before the English Parliament and the ensuing trial. His actual depredations on the high seas, whether piratical or not, were both less destructive and less lucrative than those of many other contemporary pirates and privateers.
The new leader of Vinland's elusive pirate brigade. She is always weak-willed and indecisive. A huge coward, William has the mindset of a unreliable minion right down to the marrow of her bones.
There's supposedly great dormant potential sleeping within her, but she's shown no signs of unlocking it. She wants to quit the pirate life, but also wants to be with Teach and Drake forever.
From English official site
神出鬼没の海賊集団・ヴィンランドの三代目（現）リーダー。

Based on Vlad the Impaler (also known as Vlad Tepes), who was a member of the House of Drăculești, a branch of the House of Basarab. He was posthumously dubbed Vlad the Impaler, and was a three-time Voivode of Wallachia, ruling mainly from 1456 to 1462, the period of the incipient Ottoman conquest of the Balkans.

A proud, great vampire hero who ruled over Europe's Transylvania. She suffers no damage from sunlight or crosses, but still doesn't like them. She's short, but still looks down on everyone, and speaks archaically. She doesn't like Joan of Arc.

A hero of the mysterious, ancient nation Uruk. She often fights with her best friend and comrade, Gilgamesh, to spend their time. Enkidu has also studied about humans every day lately. Seemingly, both her hair and body can be freely deformed.
"Leave it to me. Enkidu is very wise."

A knight of the Round Table who serves Arthur directly. Gawain always acts gracefully, taking to heart her role as a high-class lady. Even amongst the mighty knights of the Round Table, her battle prowess is top class.
Gawain likes black te and her tea-brewing skills have gained Arthur's stamp of approval. She never leaves her room at night.

Based on Julius Caesar, who was a Roman general, statesman, Consul, and notable author of Latin prose. He played a critical role in the events that led to the demise of the Roman Republic and the rise of the Roman Empire.

A rich lady of Rome who manages all matters financial in the European Union. As her appearance suggests, she has a gentle and easygoing personality, but when it comes to money, her senses differ from the norm by 2-3 digits, and she spends gold as it were water.
She's a genius at creating debts, but also at repaying it so she never goes bankrupt. Caesar has made it her job to look after Napoleon whenever she overworks herself.

Based on Kamehameha I, the first king of Hawaii. By developing alliances with the major Pacific colonial powers, Kamehameha preserved Hawaii's independence under his rule.
The leader of Hawaii, an island nation of the Pacific. Kamehameha is true to her natural instincts, eating when she's hungry and sleeping when she's tired. She lives her life in bliss.
She finishes all of her govermental duties in the morning, so that she can have lots of time to play. She is innocent, simple, and open-minded.

おいしいものに目がなく、任務が無い時はあちこち食べ歩きをしている。
本人曰く 「別腹が数個ある」 とのこと。
"There's plenty of seconds! Please eat your fill!"
Based on Huayna Capac, who was the eleventh Sapa Inca of the Inca Empire and sixth of the Hanan dynasty.

The hero governing the southern part of the New World. Huayna Capac has a well-mannered personality and loves taking of others, and treasures the neighboring Azteca leader Montezuma like a little sister. Her goal is to become an admirable leader that won't shame the name of her great ancestors.
She is trying very hard to get the vegetable-hating Montezuma to eat them.
From English official site
新大陸南部の古代国家インカの統治者。
礼儀正しくて世話好きな性格をしており、隣国のモンテズマを妹のようにかわいがっている。
偉大な祖先の名に恥じない、立派な指導者になるのが夢。
インカの統治者に代々伝わる、黄金の杖を探している。
趣味は料理で、野菜嫌いのモンテズマに、どうにか野菜を食べさせようと奮闘中。
新大陸南部、インカを治める英雄。
礼儀正しくて世話好きな性格をしており、隣国のモンテズマを妹のようにかわいがっている。
偉大な祖先の名に恥じない、立派な指導者になるのが夢。
"Ohhh, I'm glad. You listened to my little whim then."
Based on Abe no Seimei, an onmyouji, a leading specialist of onmyoudou during the middle of the Heian Period in Japan, and who was also a legendary figure in Japanese folklore.

Seimei is an onmyouji who runs a general store in Kyoto. She delegates most of her work to her shikigami while lounging around drinking booze all day, but she is actually quite skilled as an onmyouji.
Seimei is very easygoing and doesn't sweat the small stuff. She is also an expert at curses and magic.
From English official site
京の片隅で暮らす陰陽師英雄。
街外れでよろず屋を経営しており、店頭には宝石や人形、陶磁器など、古今東西様々な品が並んでいる。
ただし、商品はすべていわくつきの商品で、うかつに触れると危険なものばかりなので、普通の人はまず近寄らない。
主人公がジパングを統一すると、珍しいアイテムを売ってくれたり、不要なアイテムを買い取ってくれるようになる。
お酒好きで、よろず屋の奥には、秘蔵のお酒を並べた酒飲み空間があるらしい。
呪いや魔術に精通している。
ジパングの内乱には参加せず、京の片隅でよろず屋を営みつつ、隠居生活をおくる陰陽師。
身の回りのことをほとんど式神に任せ、ごろごろ転がってお酒ばかり飲んでいるものぐさな性格だが、陰陽師としての腕は確からしい。
Based on Inou Tadataka, born February 11, 1745, who was a Japanese surveyor and cartographer. He is known for completing the first map of Japan created using modern surveying techniques.
Inou's hobby is collecting infromation and is known to be very good at getting it. She also wants to make an accurate map of the world.
"My dream is to create a world map..."
測量と地図製作が趣味のジパングの英雄。
いつか世界の全てを網羅した地図を作りたいと思っている。
ジパングを測量している途中、政宗に腕を買われ、現在は仙台を拠点に全国の測量を行なっているらしい。
測量のために身につけた情報収集能力は、トップクラスの忍者にも引けを取らない。
背が低く、身長のことを指摘されると怒る。
測量と地図製作が趣味のジパングの英雄。
測量のために身につけた情報収集能力は、トップクラスの忍者にも引けを取らない。
ジパングだけでは飽きたらず、いつか世界の全てを網羅した地図を作りたいと思っている。
"Now then... that concludes today's inspections."
Based on Minamoto no Yoshitsune, who was a general of the Minamoto clan of Japan in the late Heian and early Kamakura period.
Strong in mind and body, Yoshitsune is a well-rounded hero capable of completing most tasks with ease. She governs Kyoto together with Benkei and holds a deep bond of trust with the people.
She is also in charge of Himiko and Benkei's education. She is calm and collected, wise beyond her years, and a natural beauty, but is said to be affected by a certain complex.
From English official site
知力武力共に高く、大抵のことはソツなくこなす万能型の英雄。
弁慶と一緒に統治している京都は、義経の管理のおかげでジパング一美しい都市だと言われている。
沈着冷静、頭脳明晰、容姿端麗と、完璧に見えるが、幼少時に掛けられた呪いのせいで、大きなコンプレックスを抱えているらしい。
武蔵坊弁慶と行動を共にするジパングの英雄。
知力武力共に高く、大抵のことはソツなくこなす万能型で、民からの信望も厚い。
ジパングの内乱には積極的に関わろうとせず、弁慶と一緒に京都で行方を見守っている。
とあるコンプレックスを抱えているらしいが……。
"Condemn the sin, not the sinner. It seems that was resolved peacefully."

Based on Xuanzang, who was a Chinese Buddhist monk, scholar, traveller, and translator who described the interaction between China and India in the early Tang Dynasty. Born in what is now Henan province around 602, from boyhood he took to reading religious books, including the Chinese classics and the writings of ancient sages. He became famous for his seventeen-year overland journey to India, which is recorded in detail in the classic Chinese text Great Tang Records on the Western Regions.
A Buddhist priest who punishes the evil and savors the joy of preaching. Accompanied by Goku, she travels around in order to save India, the country controlled by immorality.
Many a time does she rush to a conclusion and discipline innocent citizens. When she first meets the main character, she decides to call him "Hakkai" and forces him to let her join the Zipang army.
From English official site
お供の猿、悟空を連れて、ありがたいお経を求めてさすらう僧侶。
悪党をこらしめてお説教をすること（本人曰く「世直し」）が大好き。
正義感が強く、どんな小さな悪も見逃さない。
揉め事を見るとすかさず首を突っこみ、早とちりして、悪事に関係のない一般人を懲らしめてしまうことも多い。
初めて出会った主人公を “猪八戒” と呼び、強引にジパング軍に加わる。
説教が長すぎる。
悪党をこらしめてお説教をするのが大好きな僧。
お供の悟空を連れ、悪がはびこっているというインドを救うべく、世直しの旅を続けている。
初めて出会った主人公を “猪八戒” と呼び、強引にジパング軍に加わる。
"I appreciate your concern, but I will be all right... *cough*..."

Based on Qin Shi Huang, who was was the King of the state of Qin (r. 246–221 BC.) who conquered all other Warring States and united China in 221 BC. Rather than maintain the title of king borne by the Shang and Zhou rulers, he ruled as the First Emperor of the Qin dynasty from 220 to 210 BC.

The affectionate ruler of Taika Empire, Qin Shin Huang has a compassionate heart toward all her people. Although she is extremely prone to illness, she has the inner strength to shoulder her malady. On very good terms with Lu Bu and Sun Tzu, she is always with them, looking after them.
Qin Shi Huang seems to be seeking a tool or medicine to remove her physical weakness. She also vomits blood a lot.
From English official site
大華帝国の統治者。
身体が弱く病気がちで、気持ちがたかぶるとすぐ吐血してしまう。
自分よりも国民や仲間のことを優先する、心優しい皇帝。
すぐに吐血してしまう体質を何とかしたいと考えており、アマゾンで販売している健康グッズはあらかた試したが、ほとんど効果が無かった。
最近は食事療法を実践中で、不死の霊薬が気になっているらしい。
呂布、孫子とは仲良しで、病弱な自分を支えてくれる二人のことをとても大切に思っている。
国民への慈愛に満ちた、心優しき大華帝国の統治者。
身体が弱く病気がちだが、病に負けない芯の強さを持つ。
呂布、孫子とは仲良しで、いつも一緒に行動している。
体質を改善するための道具や薬を探し求めているらしい。
"I'll shoot you full of holes!"

Based on Oda Nobunaga, a powerful samurai daimyo and warlord of Japan in the late 16th century who initiated the unification of Japan near the end of the Warring States period. He lived a life of continuous military conquest, eventually conquering a third of Japan before his death in a 1582 coup.

Strong-willed, headstrong, ambitious. Nobunaga is the hero closest to unifying modern Zipang. She is rumored to be steadily preparing for unification by importing weapons from overseas. Himiko, with her misplaced ambition for world domination, constantly attacks her, but Nobunaga brushes off these attacks in exasperation.
From English official site
ジパングの江戸周辺を統治している英雄。
統率力や判断力に優れ、彼女の治める都市は、ジパング一の人口と税収を誇る。
珍しいもの好きで、異国から様々な物を取り寄せるのが趣味。
世界最大の通販会社「アマゾン」は、別途鎖国送料がかかってしまうため異国から割安の武器を輸入し、ヤマトタケルを倒し、鎖国を解くための戦力を増強している。
我が強く、大胆不敵な野心家。
現在ジパング統一にもっとも近いとされる英雄。
外国から新しい武器を輸入し、統一に向けて入念な準備をしているらしい。
世界征服という分不相応な目標を掲げて攻めてくるヒミコを、呆れながら撃退している。
"I like it hot enough to melt."

Based on Ishikawa Goemon, who was a semi-legendary Japanese outlaw hero who stole gold and valuables and gave them to the poor. Goemon is notable for being boiled alive along with his son in public after a failed assassination attempt on the civil war-era warlord Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
Loving manliness and acting on whatever whim takes her, Goemon is a free-spirited hero. She takes good care of others, and is often going from place to place arbitrating disputes.
Her policy of taking from the rich and giving to the poor also makes her popular with the people. She hails from Zipang, but for some reason is now residing in Australia.
From English official site
伊達と酔狂を好む、自由気ままな英雄。
面倒見が良く、困った人を放っておけない性格。
義賊としても活躍していたため、世界のあちこちで権力者と揉め事を起こしている。
基本的に強きを挫いて弱きを助けるスタンスをとっているため、住民の支持は厚い。
ジパング出身だが、現在は流れ流れてオーストラリアで暮らしている。
ジパング出身、盗みすぎてオーストラリアに逃げてきた義賊。
"If you know your enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the results of a hundred battles. This is a famous saying of mine. Remember it, because it will be on the test."
Based on Sun Zu, who was a Chinese military general, strategist, and philosopher who lived in the Spring and Autumn period of ancient China.

A military genius supporting the Taika Empire along with Lu Bu. Although she displays much self-confidence as she takes measures, any unanticipated factors easily upset her. In a nutshell, she fails to show her real ability when she needs to.
She and Lu Bu, a close friend of hers, have together been searching everywhere for a medicine capable of improving Qin Shi Huang's fragile health. She loves teaching people.
From English official site
呂布とともに大華帝国を支える英雄。
合戦の作戦立案だけでなく、戦場での指揮や戦闘参加も行う勇敢な軍師。
なぜか、敵の作戦に見事にひっかかってしまうことが多い。
病弱な始皇帝の体質を改善するため、仲良しの呂布と共に霊薬を探している。
人に物事を教えるのが好き。
自分のことを「そんちゃん先生」と呼ぶことがある。
呂布とともに大華帝国を支える軍師。
いつもは自信満々で策を講じるが、予想外のことがあるとテンパッてしまう。
一言で言うと本番に弱いタイプ。
病弱な始皇帝の体質を改善するため、仲良しの呂布と共に薬を探している。
"Yoshitsune, Benkei will fight too! Benkei will bang 'em up real good!"

Based on Musashibou Benkei, more known as Benkei, who was a Japanese warrior monk (souhei) who served Minamoto no Yoshitsune. He is commonly depicted as a man of great strength and loyalty, and a popular subject of Japanese folklore.

Benkei is the type that just rushes into the thick of things without a second thought. She holds enough monstrous strength to break boulders and rip out trees, so she frequently causes problems when she's out "playing".
She has a childish personality, but cares for her friends more than anyone else. Her hobby is collecting weapons. She'll have 1000 before long.
From English official site
義経と行動を共にする英雄。
深いことは考えず、とにかく突っ走る猪突猛進タイプ。
岩を砕いたり木を引き抜いたりするほどの怪力の持ち主で、本人は遊んでいるつもりで周囲に多大な迷惑をかけていることもしばしば。
子供っぽい性格だが、誰よりも仲間思い。
趣味は武器集めで、もうすぐ1000本集まるらしい。
義経に仕える英雄。
深いことは考えず、とにかく突っ走る猪突猛進タイプ。
岩を砕いたり木を引き抜いたりするほどの怪力の持ち主で、本人は遊んでいるつもりで周囲に多大な迷惑をかけていることもしばしば。
子供っぽい性格だが、誰よりも仲間思い。
趣味は武器集め。
"Just fight randomly, right? Leave it to sister Lu Bu!"

Based on Lü Bu, who was a military general and warlord who lived in the late Eastern Han dynasty. Originally a subordinate of a minor warlord Ding Yuan, he betrayed and murdered Ding and defected to Dong Zhuo, the warlord who controlled the Han central government in the early 190s.
A great hero of the Taika Empire serving Qin Shi Huang. To back Qin Shi Huang up, she acts like her big sister. Lu Bu and Sun Tzu are very close friends.

She usually misreads the situation without listening to other people, but her incredible strength covers up the failure. She never hesitates to go out on a limb. Together with Sun Tzu, she has been looking for a medicine that would cure Qin Shi Huang's ailing health.
From English official site
始皇帝に仕える大華帝国の英雄。
病弱な始皇帝を支える姉御的存在で、孫子とも仲良し。
人の話を聞かず、早とちりばかりしているが、それを補って余りある強さを誇る。
危険なこと、危険な場所に率先して踏み入る命知らず。
曰く「貴重なものは、いつだって危険な場所にある」。
孫子と共に、始皇帝の体質を改善するための薬を探している。
始皇帝に仕える大華帝国の英雄。
病弱な始皇帝を支える姉御的存在で、孫子とも仲良し。
人の話を聞かず、早とちりばかりしているが、それを補って余りある強さを持っている。
孫子と共に、始皇帝の体質を改善するための薬を探している。
A hero who was held captive in Valhalla, the divine realm of infinite healing and infinite madness.

In her original world, she was active in spreading the teachings of her God. However, due to her bad habit of choosing the most horrible option among all the options available to her, she came into conflict with the highest authority and found herself in dire straits.
From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
A hero who came from another world in search of a peaceful paradise.
Her original world was full of lies and violence, and
the only peaceful place was the sea, where no people lived.
Like Prester, she seems to be able to understand the language of fish, and
she learned the language of this world from the fish.
Her partner is a giant snake dragon named Jasconius.
From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
The commander of the Egyptian Necromancers.
Believing herself to be Tutankhamun's long-lost sister, she has strived to be a role model for her sister, and as a result, has become one of Egypt's formidable warriors.
She is a rare individual who can voice opinions contrary to Tutankhamun. As a Necromancer, she is still a novice, and her insides are still warm.
An ancient half-dragon Hawaiian hero watching over the beast sealed away in the Kilinoe crater.
"Grrrrr... Henoheno...!"
From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
A hero who was held captive in Valhalla.

In her original world, she was the leader of a vigilante group in a peaceful village deep in the mountains where people who had been banished because of their birth or appearance gathered, but it seems that a punitive force was sent to exterminate the village for a crime it did not commit, and the village was destroyed.
From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
A hero riding the waves of the times. She loves surfing so much that she loses track of time while riding the waves.
"Hey there! I'm Murakami!"
From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
An ancient hero who monitors the seas around Hawaii, Australia, and Aotearoa.
She fed the sealed beasts known as Zaratan, creatures which eat rocks on dragon veins, rocks from places that are not dragon veins, greatly reducing their danger.
She also informed the ancient heroes of the deliciousness of Zaratan, causing them to overfish it. Using such tricks, she was the first to exterminate a sealed beast without sealing it.
She realized that feeding ordinary crabs rocks that contain dragon vein energy will cause them to turn into Zaratans, and is currently working on cultivating Zaratans that are less dangerous.
A Hero who was exiled to Australia, who speaks in a poetic way.
Hallowed be her name in Heaven, Sanctified be her name in Hell.
"Will ye not filter the dregs that pollute your soul?"
From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
A heroine who appears in Alice Soft's "Sengoku Rance," "Rance Quest," "Rance X," etc.

The strongest swordsman in Japan, nicknamed the Goddess of War. She's always at the front lines of battle with the force of a strong wind, and there is almost no one that can stop her. She is admired by all of the female commanders in the Uesugi house.
A gladiator who appeared in the Colosseum. She is a hero from another world from WWX.
She is a bold and confident character who always bets all her money on her own victory.
"These cheers...! I can't stop!"
She retired and handed over her country to Ivan the Terrible, and is now enjoying her retirement.
"How rude... But I will forgive you."
A hero from Zipangu who joined a pirate crew in search of a warrior.
She goes wherever the waves take her in search of a worthy opponent.
”Hohoho! ‘Twoud seem your best wasn’t enough!”
A former subordinate of Ashoka, and a central figure in the Indian Civil War.
Dreams of becoming more like Ashoka when she gets all super-pissed.
”You’re gonna get it next time, bitch! Oops, I mean... Ashoka.”

segments.text: The owner and producer of a popular global brand, she started working part-time in the US Navy in search of excitement.
She thinks that whatever you do, it's best to do it with a bit of effort.
She is the number one authority on apples and apple accessories.
”No matter how bad it gets, as long as you have an apple, it’ll all be fine!”

cast.originalCharacterName: アッシュールバニパル

segments.text: Librarian at the Secret Library in Babylonia.

A text collector, she collects not only books but anything with text. She even collects manga, doujinshi, flyers, and letters addressed to individuals, so it is said that the Secret Library's collection is larger than that of the Library of Alexandria.
She willingly came to the land of exiles over a dispute with a government official.
"Unfortunately for you, I refuse to negotiate with poachers!"
The Taika Empire’s Army Commander.
Back in service after a long hiatus. Adores treating people like kids.
”Splendid work, children. You’ll receive complimentary headpats from me later.”

cast.characterName: ベンジャミン・フランクリン
cast.originalCharacterName: ベンジャミン・フランクリン

segments.text: An inventor.
Benjamin Franklin's unique ideas have brought various benefits to the USA.
"Good! The town was reduced to ashes, but the overall result is a positive one!"
She's the type who fights to kill time, but she doesn't work overtime on the battlefield.
"Hey, you! What are you looking at?!"
Seems to have a terrible past which she doesn’t want to talk about.
”Please... Just leave me alone...”
An ancient hero who was controlled by the sealed beast Odin.
Long ago, Odin used a memory manipulation spell on ​​her, making her believe she was Odin's subordinate. When the Zipang army destroyed Valhalla, Odin's control weakened, and she regained her sanity.
The Wings of Otherworld Travel and the Concept Destruction Spear she possesses are items originally created by Mu for Pandora to be used by the world's administrators.
With suspicious movements, she lures her targets into the dream world.
"I'll have to finish this quickly and move on to the next scene."

cast.characterName: カトリーヌ・ド・メディチ
cast.originalCharacterName: カトリーヌ・ド・メディチ

segments.text: A poisonous lady.
"Bravissimo! Such a great decision!"
A Russian princess from another world who came through a hole in time and space.
"Would you like to get closer to me...?"
There seems to be something she wants to protect even if she is caught.
"You've always invited my smile like that."
A Zipangu girl cast away to Russia. She seems to be receiving good treatment.
A hero who served the former Russian emperor, Rurik. Although she is Zipangu, she has the typical Russian masochistic tendencies.
"What a powerful embrace...!"
A great thief of the Dahua Empire.
She has mastered the art of stealing, such as hiding her presence and picking locks, and
it is said that there is nothing she cannot steal.

She does not steal unnecessary items, and returns stolen items with interest once she has finished using them, which is why there seems to be a trend in the Dahua Empire that "if you have your personal property stolen by Dao Zhi, you will become rich."
A hero from another world who held a martial arts tournament underground in Edo.
She is a skilled and successful magician, but lost a power struggle and was exiled to another world.

In order to return to her original world, she used a ring given to her by the devil to learn the art of time-space transfer. However, it seems that she is unable to return to her original world for some reason.
A foreign-born Knight of the Round Table, she works hard under Kay to bring glory to her hometown. She has a strong accent.
A knight fighting alone to bring discipline and order to Australia. She is originally from the EU, and there are rumors that she was a senior member of the EU military, but the details are unknown.
For now, she has no intention of returning to the EU.
One of the founding members of the Crusaders. Traveling for self-discovery in the dark realms.
"... This isn't the real me..."

A magician from the Zipangu of another world. She has incredible abilities, such as being able to effortlessly control super-powerful demons (Zenki and Koki) and imitating teleportation techniques after only seeing them a few times, but she is unaware of it.
"Sorry... Did I do something wrong?"
A heroine of justice who came from another world in pursuit of a stolen special mineral.

Using the energy generated by excitement, she fights for peace day and night. She is the transformed form of a girl named Koenji Sayuka, and in her original world, she protected the Earth from the evil organization Dai-Lust.
She currently belongs to an organization called Die-Beat, and is known as a Legendary Warrior due to her abilities.
A heroine who appears in Alice Soft's "Beat Angel Escalayer," "Beat Angel Escalayer R,"
"Beat Wars Escalation Heroines," etc.
A silent hero who communicates mostly through writing.
"That's all."
An ancient hero who was held captive in Valhalla, the divine realm of infinite healing and infinite madness.
She was swallowed by Odin ages ago and used as an energy source for magic within his body.

Originally a skilled magician, and even after being held captive within Odin's body, she attempted to escape the labyrinth by sending a part of herself to the present world, using that as a connection to it. However, once her body was sent to the present world, it turned into a dragon and went berserk, and was defeated by Siegfried and disappeared. At that time, she lost part of her human intelligence.
Fafnir's dragon form.
A hero from a ruined world.

She was brought out of the ruined world by Administrator Mu and the protagonist. The only reason she was able to escape destruction was because she never gave up hope of keeping her promise to her childhood friend.
A genius mathematician from the EU.

She was invited to serve as a special advisor to the US weapons development department, but remains with the EU. She continues to conduct research with the concept of creating weapons equivalent to those made in Atlantis without using Atlantean materials. Magnetic Armor is one of the results of her research, powered by a special and dangerous reactor that reflects lightning off the scales of the crystal dragon, Unsegira.
One of the founding members of the St. George Crusade, she continues her journey to slay evil dragons.
She came to Zipangu after hearing rumors of Yamata no Orochi, and became acquainted with the Zipangu army.
See here for a record of her dragon slaying.
A former EU musician.
She was famous as a genius composer, but retired after discovering her love for fine food. She currently works as the owner and chef of a high-class restaurant, while also researching ingredients.
Her hobby is collecting recipes.
One of the EU's leading generalists, a hero active in many fields as a writer and scholar.
